prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original seamless square RTS ground-overlay texture for AsteraCraft's citrus-tree faction. Primary request: a clean beautiful low-profile carpet of living citrus tree roots with small pools and thin channels of orange tangerine juice between the roots. True transparent background in the small gaps so the game's terrain can show through. Many fine branching woody cinnamon-brown and warm bark roots, a few medium intertwined roots, restrained juicy amber/orange highlights and tiny pulp grains. Warm natural palette: brown bark, burnt orange, mandarin orange and honey amber. Absolutely NO purple, violet, pink flesh, alien slime, veins of meat, large fruit, leaves, buildings, rocks or upright objects. Composition: uniformly distributed flat ground material filling the complete square, no central object, no border, no vignette. Seamlessly tileable in both axes: root strands and juice pattern continue across opposing edges with even density. Crisp detailed painterly prerendered RTS material, very subtle top-left lighting, low contrast microdetail, readable at small gameplay scale, not glossy plastic, no text or watermark. Ground plane viewed from directly above; the game will project it onto terrain.
